entities.summary: Omsk State Agrarian University is a public agricultural higher education institution located in the city of Omsk (Russia). The university has a 1133 hectares territory, and a green campus space located within the city. Omsk SAU consists of the main university located in Omsk, its branch in the city of Tara, and the University College of Agribusiness.
